verdict.rationale: Controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for a compliance and registered-agent service that holds customer business data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returns a Cloudflare challenge and the legacy host redirects into it. No CT Corporation content was reachable, so there is no evidence of retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
